text:
“Take as long as needed.”

Claude Code took that personally. 💀

A developer gave it a prompt + reference screenshot and let it coordinate subagents. Roughly 12 hours without another message later, it returned a playable RPG.

Village, forest, dungeon. Four party members. Turn-based combat with shield breaks and boosts.

The wild part: no image, model or audio files. Every sprite, texture, song and sound effect is generated in code when the page loads.

The developer polished it and fixed bugs afterward. The current first chapter is about a 4 MB download with an hour of gameplay.

That’s an approach worth testing: procedural assets let a coding agent work on visuals, audio and gameplay through the same coding workflow.

Would you leave a coding agent running for 12 hours unattended?
